title: In Hinglish, the Branding page is almost all in English
what: An owner who chose Hinglish taps the Hinglish menu row (Logo aur rang) or the Hinglish set-up step (Apna logo aur rang daalo) and lands on a page titled Branding where every heading, button, tip, error and the note after saving stays English. Only the two small hints under the colour boxes switch to Hinglish, so the page reads half and half.
expected: The Branding page reads in Hinglish when Hinglish is on, like the menu row and set-up step that lead to it; at least its title, buttons and the note after saving.
how_often: every visit to Branding in Hinglish
fix_line: Send the Branding words through the Hinglish word list and add the missing Hinglish lines.

title: On a first visit to Branding the Save button is greyed with no reason
what: A gym that has never saved a look opens Branding and sees Save greyed out. Nothing next to it says why. The Saved note only shows once a look was saved, so a new owner may think the page is broken until they change the colour or add a logo.
expected: Next to the greyed Save, a short line says what to do first, for example: Upload your logo or pick a colour, then Save.
who: owners setting up branding for the first time
fix_line: Show a short line by Save when nothing has been changed and nothing was saved yet.

title: The old ForgeAI admin icons are still served next to the new MettleUp ones
what: Three old app icons with the ForgeAI hex-nut mark are still published by the admin site, and a deploy test insists they stay. A phone or computer that saved the admin app before the rename, or any page that still points at them, keeps showing the old brand.
expected: Only MettleUp pictures are served; the old addresses show the MettleUp admin icon instead of the ForgeAI one.
who: owners and staff who installed the admin app before the rename
how_often: every time the old icon shows
fix_line: Replace the three old icon files with copies of the MettleUp admin icon at the same addresses.

items.reason: Hindi read-aloud list (every Hinglish line this area shows): Logo aur rang; Apna logo aur rang daalo; Members ko unki app mein aapka logo aur rang dikhta hai; Aapke members ki MettleUp app yeh rang apne buttons, highlights aur charts ke liye use karti hai; Aapke members ki MettleUp app yeh dark rang apne pages ke liye use karti hai, aur cards ko thoda halka banati hai. No banned-word list was given, none checked.
The area has no live sign-in or legal page (the old sign-in screen is unused); legal pages sit in the public web pages area.
No tapped-notification handler in this area; the admin app handles taps in its bell screens and the web worker, outside these folders.
No words in this area promise that every look or change is recorded.
Follows H10.15: no record promise in this area.
